quotes.name: Mirage Mirror
quotes.flavor: Most mirrors show your reflection. Others show your potential.

quotes.name: Myr Custodian
quotes.flavor:
"Myr will go where the work is. We always have. We always will."
—Urtet, Remnant of Memnarch

quotes.name: Sand Strangler
quotes.flavor: The bombardment of sand disorients, chokes, and ultimately tenderizes its prey.

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Harrier Strix
quotes.flavor: It can see in both darkness and daylight, but it hunts best when thunder growls in the sky.

quotes.name: Clearwater Pathway // Murkwater Pathway
quotes.flavor:
"Just when the river seems most peaceful, suddenly you round a bend and hurtle down a waterfall."
—Zahr Gada, Halimar expedition leader

quotes.name: Squeeze
quotes.flavor: Any pirate would prefer Rishada's swift and cruel justice to Saprazzo's patient punishments.

quotes.name: Isolation Zone
quotes.flavor: When properly aligned, hedrons become powerful tools of binding.

quotes.name: Scheming Symmetry
quotes.flavor:
ONE FOR ME
ONE FOR YOU

quotes.name: Packsong Pup
quotes.flavor: A wolf pup is always dangerous, because a wolf pup is never alone.

quotes.name: Hulk, Brutal Brawler
quotes.flavor: "Puny Banner thinks he can keep me locked away! I want to be free!"

quotes.name: Tyvar, the Pummeler
quotes.flavor: "They just keep coming and coming—perfect for my morning workout!"

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor:
"It has been my honor to improve on Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship

quotes.name: Dread Return
quotes.flavor: Those who forget the horrors of the past are doomed to re-meet them.

quotes.name: Stormplain Detainment
quotes.flavor: Elspeth saw their capture as an inconvenience, costing them precious time. Narset saw it as an opportunity to recruit allies to their cause.

quotes.name: Anguished Unmaking
quotes.flavor: James flooded the room with radiation, ensuring Project Purity would not fall into Enclave hands. With his last breath, he told his child to run.

quotes.name: Giant Adephage
quotes.flavor:
"To a creature like that, we must seem like, well, bugs."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

quotes.name: Curious Farm Animals
quotes.flavor: Earth Kingdom cuisine offers a stunning array of unique meats, like chicken-pork, deer-pork, and beef-pork.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Hulk
quotes.flavor:
It doesn't think. It doesn't feel.
It doesn't laugh or cry.
All it does from dusk till dawn
Is make the soldiers die.
—Onean children's rhyme

quotes.name: Falkenrath Aristocrat
quotes.flavor: "Your blood is quite pleasing. A pity there's not enough for both of us."

quotes.name: Triumphant Chomp
quotes.flavor: With crunchy outer shells and juicy innards, cave crawlers quickly became a favorite snack of the Sun Empire's dinosaur companions.

quotes.name: Vraska's Contempt
quotes.flavor: It wasn't long before the taverns of High and Dry were full of whispers about the new captain who could turn a person to stone with a glance.

quotes.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
quotes.flavor: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

quotes.name: Clear Shot
quotes.flavor:
"What worked to bring down angels will do the same for these horrors."
—Rem Karolus, Slayer of Eldrazi

quotes.name: Courier Bat
quotes.flavor: Swarms of bats poured from Lurenbraum Fortress carrying wedding invitations to vampires of every bloodline.

quotes.name: Restore
quotes.flavor:
"See, the land itself raises an altar to the ascendancy of nature."
—Mayael the Anima

quotes.name: Ritual of Rejuvenation
quotes.flavor: "Nothing is more sacred than the gift of blood. Blessed are the vein that empties and the heart that is renewed."

quotes.name: Flamekin Spitfire
quotes.flavor: Some flamekin warriors explore the art of coherence, an ancient discipline that harnesses the chaos of fire and focuses it with pinpoint precision.

quotes.name: Roil Cartographer
quotes.flavor: "The world shifts constantly, but that doesn't mean it can't be mapped. Our maps must shift as well."

quotes.name: Ingenious Leonin
quotes.flavor: Leonin claws were already deadly weapons of natural evolution before he improved upon them.

quotes.name: Sauté
quotes.flavor:
"Selecting the proper beeble is the key to a good sauté. The pinker the fur and the heartier the yelp, the more succulent the beeble will be when you pop it in your mouth."
—Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, *The Underworld Cookbook*

quotes.name: Wall of Brambles
quotes.flavor: "What else, when chaos draws all forces inward to shape a single leaf." —Conrad Aiken

quotes.name: Bellowing Aegisaur
quotes.flavor: Its roaring challenge is punctuated by the slam of its tail on the earth, rousing the herds of the plains.

quotes.name: Liminal Hold
quotes.flavor: A reliquary is needed to pass through the eclipse safely. Without it, two warring selves will calcify into one.

quotes.name: Spontaneous Artist
quotes.flavor: Graffiti of the "leaking spire" symbol is found wherever the renegades have been.

quotes.name: Mobilized District
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.

quotes.name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
quotes.flavor: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Cascade Bluffs
quotes.flavor: Travelers bathe in the falls to wash away curses from the pucas who lurk nearby.

quotes.name: Hypersonic Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"Even this primitive specimen of my kind is impressive."
—Niv-Mizzet

quotes.name: Artillery Blast
quotes.flavor: To conserve ammunition, Jhoira modified ancient Thran artillery cannons to fire gouts of pure Shivan lava.

quotes.name: Loyal Subordinate
quotes.flavor: Zombies work best when they're fed appropriately, so it's prudent to let them eat on the job.

quotes.name: Naya Panorama
quotes.flavor: Between the thunderous footfalls of Naya's behemoths lie moments of perfect quiet.

quotes.name: Baloth Woodcrasher
quotes.flavor: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

quotes.name: Startling Development
quotes.flavor: Remarkably, dinner continued with no further interruptions.

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, how I love gold. I'd eat and breathe it if I could."
—Leland, tax collector

quotes.name: Ceaseless Searblades
quotes.flavor: Flamekins' fires burn cool until they decide otherwise.

quotes.name: Celestial Purge
quotes.flavor:
"They say only the good die young. Obviously, you are one of the exceptions."
—Delrobah, cleric of Ivora Gate

quotes.name: Hunter's Edge
quotes.flavor: The hunt ends. Lunch begins.

quotes.name: Nomad Decoy
quotes.flavor: If you can take something from a nomad, it's probably bait.

quotes.name: Angelic Sleuth
quotes.flavor: Some crime scenes' secrets can only be discerned from an angel's-eye view.

quotes.name: Avid Reclaimer
quotes.flavor: "All can't be lost. Nissa has shown me that."

quotes.name: Abrade
quotes.flavor: The Falkenrath progenitor was a vicious falconer, and the line is quick to remind others of its heritage.

quotes.name: B.F.M. (Big Furry Monster)
quotes.flavor:
than that. Even bigger. Keep going. More.
dreadnoughts for jewelry. It was *big*!"
—Arna Kennerüd, skyknight

quotes.name: Rotfeaster Maggot
quotes.flavor: Is it at the top of the food chain or the bottom?

quotes.name: Urza's Engine
quotes.flavor:
"Humans and machines working together can be fearsome indeed!"
—Arcum Dagsson

quotes.name: Imperial Seal
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, for heaven's sake, of course it was a death threat! What did you think was in an envelope like that, a wedding invitation?"
—Magistrate's assistant

quotes.name: Falkenrath Reaver
quotes.flavor:
"Each day there are new reports of homes along Getander Pass and Hofsaddel falling to vampires of a more savage nature. I've even heard tell that Anje Falkenrath has returned. Please send whatever help you can."
—Sterin Gorn, letter to Thalia

quotes.name: Lone Wolf
quotes.flavor: A wolf without a pack is either a survivor or a brute.

quotes.name: Elite Archers
quotes.flavor: They fletch their arrows with the feathers of angels.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: When defeat is near and guidance is scarce, all eyes look in one direction.

quotes.name: Mind Rot
quotes.flavor: Not every thought is a good one.

quotes.name: Ghostly Touch
quotes.flavor: "Geists wish to make themselves known. I'm merely the vessel for their efforts."

quotes.name: Turn Aside
quotes.flavor:
"There are tides beyond those in the sea that are driven by Innistrad's silver moon. If you learn their patterns, you can channel them in fascinating ways."
—Tamiyo

quotes.name: Spoils of Blood
quotes.flavor:
"There are always leftovers."
—Derecht, flesh carver

quotes.name: Natural Order
quotes.flavor: . . . but the price of Mangara's freedom was Asmira's life.

quotes.name: An-Zerrin Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"The An-Zerrins have served me well, ever since I first killed them."
—Baron Sengir

quotes.name: Uktabi Faerie
quotes.flavor:
Victim of the two-toed faerie
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "broken"

quotes.name: Rite of Replication
quotes.flavor: "Eorzea is mine by right!"

quotes.name: Floodgate
quotes.flavor:
"Quick, Rhirhok—teach me to swim!"
—Makht, goblin casualty

quotes.name: Nirkana Revenant
quotes.flavor: Hate is an everlasting wellspring from which she is eternally sustained.

quotes.name: Furious Assault
quotes.flavor:
"Does it burn, Saprazzan? Do you wish you had never raised arms against us?"
—Kyren overseer

quotes.name: Belligerent Brontodon
quotes.flavor: Predators try to separate the young, old, or injured from the rest of the herd. The alternative is crushing defeat.

quotes.name: Unexplained Disappearance
quotes.flavor: The first thing the mist chills is the mind. Victims never cry out or even murmur in surprise.

quotes.name: Stalwart Valkyrie
quotes.flavor: "Only the worthy may pass."

quotes.name: Yennett, Cryptic Sovereign
quotes.flavor: She talks using riddles her disciples alone can unravel.

quotes.name: Tree Monkey
quotes.flavor: The vines and branches of the jungle canopy are all the wings it needs.

quotes.name: Desperate Charge
quotes.flavor: "Lieutenants dishonored, corpses carted home; The general raises troops again to take revenge."

quotes.name: Nekrataal
quotes.flavor:
"You can't protect them all, Jace."
—Vraska

quotes.name: Orzhov Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Digester
quotes.flavor:
"Our cause will ripen in the fertile flesh of the unworthy."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Stampeding Wildebeests
quotes.flavor: The most violent and destructive storms in Femeref occur on cloudless days.

quotes.name: Ironshell Beetle
quotes.flavor:
"Please don't feed the beetles."
—Promenade warning sign

quotes.name: Fracturing Gust
quotes.flavor: Elvish dawnhands test a relic's worthiness before collecting it for the safehold. If it can't stand up to a stiff breeze, it's left behind.

quotes.name: Nut Collector
quotes.flavor: "I'll call you Reginald, and you're Mimi, and you're Tank, and you're Bobo..."

quotes.name: Boulderbranch Golem
quotes.flavor:
"Artifice is not the only form of creation."
—Titania

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: The Changer of Ways often sends glimpses of possible futures to his most loyal acolytes, visions that would destroy lesser minds.

quotes.name: Gold-Forged Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Blessed by the gods. Coveted by mortals. Beholden to neither.

quotes.name: Rewind
quotes.flavor:
"Time flows like a river. In Tolaria we practice the art of building dams."
—Barrin, master wizard

quotes.name: Windstorm
quotes.flavor:
"We don't like interlopers and thieves cluttering our skies."
—Dionus, elvish archdruid

quotes.name: Plague Mare
quotes.flavor: When it passes, those who sleep dream of sickness and death.

quotes.name: Tawnos's Weaponry
quotes.flavor: When war machines became too costly, Tawnos's weaponry replaced them.

quotes.name: Ride Guide
quotes.flavor: "When riding Erebos's Whip, remember to keep your arms, legs, and any strange flailing appendages inside the vehicle at all times."

quotes.name: Dulcet Sirens
quotes.flavor: What are the orders of a king or the demands of a creed next to such melodies?

quotes.name: Jill, Shiva's Dominant // Shiva, Warden of Ice
quotes.flavor: "I'm going to help you. To give you what you need to protect us all."

quotes.name: Arachnoid
quotes.flavor: It follows the green sun over Mirrodin's surface, spinning massive webs of whispersilk as it goes.

quotes.name: Act of Treason
quotes.flavor:
"Rage courses in every heart, yearning to betray its rational prison."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Breaking of the Fellowship
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "It might have been mine. It should be mine. Give it to me!"

quotes.name: Spectral Shepherd
quotes.flavor: The restless geists of common folk often continue their lifelong labors.

quotes.name: Diabolic Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"Show them. Show them how hot your fire can burn."
—Liliana Vess, to Chandra Nalaar

quotes.name: Wildwood Rebirth
quotes.flavor: In Ravnica, there are maladies far more difficult to treat than death.

quotes.name: Bulk Up
quotes.flavor:
「噛みつき砕く我が歯牙よ、引き裂き穿つ我が爪よ、怒りに震える我が心よ、狂気の高みへ連れてゆけ。」
――「カソーラの戦唄」第一巻

quotes.name: Tireless Provisioner
quotes.flavor: She won't let you leave her home with an empty belly!

quotes.name: Rat Colony
quotes.flavor: Wreckage from the Phyrexian Invasion provided the rats with a seemingly unlimited number of breeding grounds.

quotes.name: Spinehorn Minotaur
quotes.flavor: "If you think twice, I'll cut twice."

quotes.name: Waterlogged Grove
quotes.flavor:
"Beware the Sphere. Beware Skagra. Beware Shada."
—Professor Chronotis

quotes.name: Kessig Wolfrider
quotes.flavor: "It's a perfect partnership. My village is safe from wolf attacks, and she gets to eat any vampires we catch."

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor:
"Our ancestors brought down a Phyrexian portal ship, then built our town on its hull. We're pretty proud of that."
—Alene of Riverspan

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

quotes.name: Beast Within
quotes.flavor:
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them."
―Euphemia, Nexus watcher

quotes.name: Bog Wraith
quotes.flavor: The bodies of its victims are the only tracks it leaves.

quotes.name: Kess, Dissident Mage
quotes.flavor: "Loss has no meaning here. You cannot take from those who have nothing."

quotes.name: Ray of Revelation
quotes.flavor: Webs of illusion unravel in the light of truth.

quotes.name: Civic Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: "These alleys are not safe. Come, I can guide you back to the market square."

quotes.name: Chase Stein, Runaway
quotes.flavor: The Steins lamented their son didn't inherit their genius. Chase was just glad he didn't inherit their evil.

quotes.name: Essence Drain
quotes.flavor:
"Life's essence is a nectar unlike any I tasted when I lived as a mortal."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Ashen-Skin Zubera
quotes.flavor: When the Honden of Night's Reach began to crumble, its attendants swarmed Kamigawa to haunt mortal dreams.

quotes.name: MJ, Rising Star
quotes.flavor: "Will they? Won't they? Find out next time, on the season finale of *Secret Hospital.*"

quotes.name: Simic Signet
quotes.flavor: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

quotes.name: Throne of the God-Pharaoh
quotes.flavor: Crafted from the poisoned bones of wyverns by Snake Mountain's first inhabitants.

quotes.name: Geomancer's Gambit
quotes.flavor: Telepathy changes minds, necromancy changes lives, but geomancy changes the world.

quotes.name: Ghitu Lavarunner
quotes.flavor: Tolarians teach the theory of pyromancy. The Ghitu prefer applied research.

quotes.name: Spotcycle Scouter
quotes.flavor: Hard light. Hard attitude.

quotes.name: Wakandan Tusker
quotes.flavor:
"Elephants have worn this armor since ancient times, defending Wakanda as bravely as any warrior."
—Zuri, warrior of Wakanda

quotes.name: Castle Embereth
quotes.flavor: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

quotes.name: Palladium Myr
quotes.flavor: The myr are like the Glimmervoid: blank canvases on which to build grand creations.

quotes.name: Emergent Growth
quotes.flavor: "By accepting my smallness I am vast."

quotes.name: Hinterland Harbor
quotes.flavor: Legolas built a grey ship in Ithilien, and sailed down Anduin and so over Sea; and with him, it was said, went Gimli the Dwarf.

quotes.name: Malfunction
quotes.flavor: "They don't make them like they used to."

quotes.name: Severed Strands
quotes.flavor: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

quotes.name: Sonar Strike
quotes.flavor: Valley's midnight clerics channel the life force of other animals into blinding strikes and searing shrieks.

quotes.name: Worldsoul's Rage
quotes.flavor: "Hoarding supplies, profiting from death and destruction, colluding with the invaders—every one of them betrayed Ravnica in its time of greatest need. They all deserved to die. And I'm not done yet!"

quotes.name: Four Knocks
quotes.flavor: "Wilfred, it's my honor. Better be quick. Three, two, one."

quotes.name: Elvish Pioneer
quotes.flavor: "Destruction is the work of an afternoon. Creation is the work of a lifetime."

quotes.name: Savai Thundermane
quotes.flavor: A crackling roar is the last sound many hunters hear.

quotes.name: Infiltrator's Magemark
quotes.flavor:
"In secrecy is strength. None can oppose one who cannot be found."
—Szadek

quotes.name: Goblin Oriflamme
quotes.flavor:
"It was difficult to tell whether the piles of gore within their warrens were mere trash heaps, sacred altars, or warnings."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. IV*

quotes.name: Wall of Swords
quotes.flavor: Just as the evil ones approached to slay Justina, she cast a great spell, imbuing her weapons with her own life force. Thus she fulfilled the prophecy: "In the death of your savior will you find salvation."

quotes.name: Bloodsworn Steward
quotes.flavor: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

quotes.name: Bloodtracker
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

quotes.name: Wartime Protestors
quotes.flavor: Fire Lord Ozai's cruel reign only forged a stronger resolve in the hearts of the resistance.

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: Once, the "Houses of Tomorrow." Now, the tombs of today.

quotes.name: Valeron Outlander
quotes.flavor: After years of honing her philosophy in debate with stubborn rhoxes, Niella was ready to convert any heathen.

quotes.name: Nausea
quotes.flavor: No fear. No sense. And soon, no lunch.

quotes.name: Earth Servant
quotes.flavor:
"Fire. Air. Water. These elements spread, filling in the spaces they are not. But earth is implacable like a sullen child."
—Jestus Dreya, *Of Elements and Eternity*

quotes.name: Farhaven Elf
quotes.flavor: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

quotes.name: People of the Woods
quotes.flavor:
"Their rain of arrows left only myself alive, cowering within a tree hollow. They did not even come out to loot the bodies."
—Vervamon the Elder

quotes.name: Bonepicker Skirge
quotes.flavor:
"Get away from there! I must rebuild that one for the next bout. Shoo, shoo!"
—Keskit, the Flesh Sculptor

quotes.name: Leonin Lightscribe
quotes.flavor: All who hear his inspiring words are filled with hope and pride.

quotes.name: Needle Storm
quotes.flavor: The rain is driven like nails.

quotes.name: Grafted Identity
quotes.flavor: Autonomy is only skin deep.

quotes.name: Honor of the Pure
quotes.flavor: Together the soldiers were like a golden blade, cutting down their enemies and scarring the darkness.

quotes.name: Glimmer Bairn
quotes.flavor: "Tricks and treats, souls and sweets! On wooded path, whom shall we meet?"

quotes.name: Rip Apart
quotes.flavor: "How kind," she thought. "They've filled another room with claw sharpeners."

quotes.name: Iroas's Champion
quotes.flavor: Accustomed to battling before an audience in the arena, Iroas's champions know how to put on a good show.

quotes.name: Traverse the Outlands
quotes.flavor: With such great footsteps, everything is within walking distance.

quotes.name: Path to Exile
quotes.flavor: Mysterious Visitor Saves Town, Vanishes

quotes.name: Fiery Islet
quotes.flavor:
"We'll use this ship as a battering ram to hit all of the others, creating a massive temporal reaction. Takes the ships, and all the Sontarans on Earth, out of existence. Huge temporal bang."
—Karvanista

quotes.name: Wedding Announcement // Wedding Festivity
quotes.flavor: Vampires from every bloodline mingled together, all swelling with pride to be seen at the event of the century.

quotes.name: Trusty Machete
quotes.flavor:
"Until this expedition is done, that blade is your guardian, your liberator, and your best friend all rolled into one."
—Yon Basrel, Oran-Rief survivalist

quotes.name: Almost Perfect
quotes.flavor: An incomplete suit of power armor is still a suit of power armor.

quotes.name: Call of the Ring
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "The Ring is mine!"

quotes.name: Goblin Piker
quotes.flavor: Once he'd worked out which end of the thing was sharp, he was promoted to guard duty.

quotes.name: Moon Sprite
quotes.flavor:
"I am that merry wanderer of the night."
—William Shakespeare,
*A Midsummer Night's Dream*

quotes.name: Hammer of Ruin
quotes.flavor: By hammer forged, and by hammer undone.

quotes.name: Timber Wolves
quotes.flavor: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

quotes.name: Ramunap Excavator
quotes.flavor: "This world was once so much more than the confines of Naktamun."

quotes.name: Nightmare
quotes.flavor: The Nightmare arises from its lair in the swamps. As the poisoned land spreads, so does the Nightmare's rage and terrifying strength.

quotes.name: Crashing Drawbridge
quotes.flavor:
"The Northern Beacon flared, and even before the drawbridge finished its descent, the knights charged out."
—*Legend of the Gilded Knights*

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: If you feel the mountains of Shiv rumble, pray the volcanos are awakening—and not the dragons.

quotes.name: Greenwood Sentinel
quotes.flavor: Within a mile of the woodland, you will feel her eyes upon you. Within its borders, you will feel her blade.

quotes.name: Barrage of Expendables
quotes.flavor: Goblin generals don't distinguish between troops and ammunition.

quotes.name: End-Raze Forerunners
quotes.flavor:
"Smash this city to pieces."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Farhaven Elf
quotes.flavor: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

quotes.name: Canyon Vaulter
quotes.flavor: Some seek thrills in watching the show. Some seek thrills in being the show.

quotes.name: Kor Sanctifiers
quotes.flavor: "Why keep such trinkets? They only add weight to your travels."

quotes.name: Skyshaper
quotes.flavor:
"It'll get us to the portal, but I can't guarantee what it'll do to the ship."
—Hanna, *Weatherlight* navigator

quotes.name: Deadly Allure
quotes.flavor: What could be more irresistible than death?

quotes.name: True Polymorph
quotes.set_name: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms Promos
quotes.flavor: Maybe a little *too* convincing.

quotes.name: Cerulean Sphinx
quotes.flavor:
"About the sphinx, I have mixed feelings. Their wisdom I crave, but their secrecy I can't tolerate."
—Szadek

quotes.name: Bilbo's Ring
quotes.flavor: He goes on living, never looking a day older.

quotes.name: Destroy Evil
quotes.flavor: Serra's grace most often manifests as a healing touch, but it may also grant a merciful death.

quotes.name: Night's Whisper
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?"
—Vraska

quotes.name: Alabaster Mage
quotes.flavor:
"We hold sacred the powers of light and life. Truth and honor are our greatest weapons."
—Alabaster creed

quotes.name: Mirkwood Bats
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"The enemy has many spies and many ways of hearing."
—Gandalf

quotes.name: Mystic Skull // Mystic Monstrosity
quotes.flavor: It waited on the barn wall for decades, forgotten, looking for the perfect opportunity.

quotes.name: Haunted Crossroads
quotes.flavor: It seemed as if no one wanted them to reach the Henge of Ramos—not even the dead.

quotes.name: Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle
quotes.flavor: "The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."

quotes.name: Planar Bridge
quotes.flavor: Its power levels are off the charts.

quotes.name: Winds of Rath
quotes.flavor:
"There shall be a vast shout and then a vaster silence."
—Oracle *en-*Vec

quotes.name: Sunken Hollow
quotes.flavor: On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.

quotes.name: Embereth Skyblazer
quotes.flavor: "We fight with valor in our hearts and fire in our veins!"

quotes.name: Peter Parker's Camera
quotes.flavor:
"How does Parker get those close-ups?"
—J. Jonah Jameson

quotes.name: Ranger's Firebrand
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"Keep close to the fire, with your faces outward! Get some of the longer sticks ready in your hands!"
—Strider

quotes.name: Saltwater Stalwart
quotes.flavor: Every attack is a test of your defenses. Every hit marks the map of your defeat.

quotes.name: Thragtusk
quotes.flavor:
"Always carry two spears."
—Mokgar, Kalonian hunter

quotes.name: Vulshok Sorcerer
quotes.set_name: Premium Deck Series: Fire and Lightning
quotes.flavor: Vulshok sorcerers train by leaping into electrified storm clouds. Dead or alive, they come back down with smiles on their faces.

quotes.name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
quotes.flavor: The earth walks, strongest of all.

quotes.name: Rotting Giant
quotes.flavor: Wracked with rot, it wrecks and ruins.

quotes.name: Plated Slagwurm
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor: Beneath the Tangle, the wurm tunnels stretch . . . wide as a stone's throw, long as forever, deep as you dare.

quotes.name: Tavern Swindler
quotes.flavor: Rakdos cultists are her best customers. They never flinch at pain and are seldom good at math.

quotes.name: Meandering River
quotes.flavor:
"Everywhere you look, this world is healing from its wounds. Aren't you ready to do the same?"
—Jhoira, to Teferi

quotes.name: Blood Pet
quotes.flavor: No thrull has ever been burdened with a long life.

quotes.name: Guidelight Synergist
quotes.flavor: "Declarative: A unit is only as strong as its network."

quotes.name: Flowstone Kavu
quotes.flavor: The kavu adjusted easily to the Rathi overlay, incorporating the invasive flowstone into their own adaptable forms.

quotes.name: Wild Ricochet
quotes.flavor:
"May your day never match your expectations."
—Scriptus Fleen, flectomancer

quotes.name: Ghostly Changeling
quotes.flavor: In desolate places, changelings may take the shape of fancies, or memories, or fears.

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

quotes.name: Avenger of Zendikar
quotes.flavor: Vengeance is a brew best served chilled.

quotes.name: Direct Hit
quotes.flavor: Beware a Klingon with a short temper and a big grudge.

quotes.name: Broadside Bombardiers
quotes.flavor:
"Who is supplying them all these skulls?!"
—Captain Billiam Dridge, deceased

quotes.name: Treasure Trove
quotes.flavor: Karn and Hanna stood over the recovered Legacy artifacts like loving parents over sleeping children.

quotes.name: Kujar Seedsculptor
quotes.flavor: Every leaf, tree, and building in Kujar has been placed to achieve maximum harmony, in accordance with the elvish philosophy known as the Great Conduit.

quotes.name: Urborg Uprising
quotes.flavor: In Urborg, few things are less permanent than death.

quotes.name: Razortide Bridge
quotes.flavor: In order to join the Order of the Tadpole, one must pass an athletics test that requires participants to run along the bridge, contending with feral ghouls, bloodbugs, and the bridge's dilapidated state. Don't forget to stretch!

quotes.name: Old-Growth Educator
quotes.flavor:
"Here is my most important lesson: Within all life dwells a living essence. You must decide for yourselves how you'll use that knowledge."
—Professor Longbranch

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Slay
quotes.flavor: The elves had the edge in guile, skill, and valor. But in the end, only sheer numbers mattered.

quotes.name: Contaminated Bond
quotes.flavor:
"My favorite curses are those that manifest slowly, blackening the soul in ways the victim cannot hope to understand."
—Erissa, bog witch

quotes.name: Cloud Key
quotes.flavor: The advent of cloudsculpting ended the use of mechanical locks in Illvoi society.

quotes.name: Warship Scout
quotes.flavor: "For the glory of the Fire Nation!"

quotes.name: Kothophed, Soul Hoarder
quotes.flavor: "I will be your most demanding master, Liliana. But I have great things in mind for you."

quotes.name: Phyrexian Reclamation
quotes.flavor: Death is no excuse to stop working.

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Edric, Spymaster of Trest
quotes.flavor: "I am not at liberty to reveal my sources, but I can assure you, the price on your head is high."

quotes.name: Fynn, the Fangbearer
quotes.flavor: "I always said I had a score to settle with that serpent. I'm a man of my word."

quotes.name: Blessed Orator
quotes.flavor:
"He spoke with the tongue of Angels; we fought with the strength of lions."
—Handel, infantry soldier

quotes.name: Self-Reflection
quotes.flavor: Some Echoes remember every moment of their past lives and spend their existence contemplating past choices.

quotes.name: Rakdos, the Showstopper
quotes.flavor: "Entertain me."

quotes.name: Fighting Drake
quotes.flavor: Scholars in their ivory towers call them "sharks of the sky." Scholars on the road don't call them at all.

quotes.name: Reclamation Sage
quotes.flavor: "What was once formed by masons, shaped by smiths, or given life by mages, I will return to the embrace of the earth."

quotes.name: Ignoble Hierarch
quotes.flavor: He protects the fetid bog from light, life, and the hideous sound of laughter.

quotes.name: Kongming, "Sleeping Dragon"
quotes.flavor: "Such a lord as this—all virtues' height—Had never been, nor ever was again."

quotes.name: Canal Courier
quotes.flavor: The most effective roadways in Paliano aren't roads at all.

quotes.name: Unleash Fury
quotes.flavor: Might doesn't make right, but it does win the fight.

quotes.name: Llanowar Elves
quotes.flavor: "When lumberjacks bring axes, trees bring us."

quotes.name: Nature's Blessing
quotes.flavor:
"Be open to the blessings, whatever their form."
—Kaysa, elder druid of the Juniper Order

quotes.name: Song of Totentanz
quotes.flavor: Townsfolk tapped their feet and hummed along, unwittingly amplifying the tune that would summon their doom.

quotes.name: Dragon Engine
quotes.flavor: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor:
"This is the Source. This is what you're fighting over. A device to rejuvenate a planet's ecosystem."
—The Tenth Doctor

quotes.name: Yasharn, Implacable Earth
quotes.flavor: In its hoofprints, barren dust becomes fertile ground.

quotes.name: Paradox Engine
quotes.flavor:
"One look at this glorious item convinced me that Kaladesh deserved my full attention. Sure enough, my time here has yielded exquisite fruit."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Defend the Rider
quotes.flavor: Lagorin would not lose another.

quotes.name: Fearsome Temper
quotes.flavor: Purphoros is god of creation and destruction, which makes him the most creatively destructive god in the pantheon.

quotes.name: Sapphire Medallion
quotes.flavor: It is the glimpse of a new horizon beyond the hills, the briny taste of salt spray off a ship's hull, and the whisper of pages turning in a new book. It is discovery.

quotes.name: Towashi Songshaper
quotes.flavor: Most Uprisers augment their bodies for speed, strength, or protection, but a few just want to be one with the music.

quotes.name: Oversoul of Dusk
quotes.flavor:
"Some say she hid the sun herself, a desperate act to save it from its ultimate extinction."
—*The Seer's Parables*

quotes.name: Evolution Sage
quotes.flavor: "To care for yourself, cultivate the world. To care for the world, cultivate yourself."

quotes.name: Overgrown Tomb
quotes.flavor: Cradle of the Golgari's new kingdom. Grave of those who wronged its queen.

quotes.name: Vedalken Blademaster
quotes.flavor: Vedalken have six thin, agile fingers on each hand, giving them unparalleled dexterity.

quotes.name: Topple the Statue
quotes.flavor: Bolas cared little when his statue fell, thinking it a useful distraction, underestimating the surge of resolve it gave his opponents.

quotes.name: Riveteers Overlook
quotes.flavor: Along the outer girders, in gold filigree, are inscribed the names of all those who fell to their deaths during construction.

quotes.name: Tattered Mummy
quotes.flavor: The dead who wander beyond the safety of the city crave only to spread their curse.

quotes.name: Inspiring Call
quotes.flavor: "Hahahahaha!"

quotes.name: Dingus Egg
quotes.flavor: Legend has it that the world was hatched from a dingus egg.

quotes.name: Owen Grady, Raptor Trainer
quotes.flavor: "I don't control the raptors. It's a relationship. It's based on mutual respect."

quotes.name: Steel-Plume Marshal
quotes.flavor: The defenders watched in terror as the flying V split apart into a bristling battle formation.

quotes.name: Nashi, Moon's Legacy
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: The story circle continues.

quotes.name: Mikokoro, Center of the Sea
quotes.flavor:
"Center of the Sea, Eye of the World, Shrine of Enlightenment. Seek it for answers. Seek it for healing. Seek it and return transformed."
—Scroll fragment from the ruins of Minamo

quotes.name: Devoted Duelist
quotes.flavor: "Arrows? Ha! Wood and feather? Toys!"

quotes.name: Moan of the Unhallowed
quotes.flavor: For a ghoul, every village is a buffet and every disaster is a reunion.

quotes.name: Minamo, School at Water's Edge
quotes.flavor: Its students graduate the school and enter history.

quotes.name: Mutinous Massacre
quotes.flavor: There is no blade sharper than betrayal.

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: Slain orochi warriors were buried with a tree sapling so they would become a part of the forest after death.

quotes.name: Merfolk Trickster
quotes.flavor: Saved from destruction by one planeswalker's sacrifice, the Eliterate colony forswore the taking of life.

quotes.name: Maalfeld Twins
quotes.flavor:
"Who am I to break up a family?"
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Huatli's Spurring
quotes.flavor: "Run like the wind, fierce one. The hunt has begun."

quotes.name: Faithless Looting
quotes.flavor: "Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"

quotes.name: Warrior's Honor
quotes.flavor:
"We are to be bound together as the reeds of a basket."
—Asmira, Rashida, and Jabari, unity chant

quotes.name: Talisman of Indulgence
quotes.flavor:
"Embrace your hunger, your lust, your desire. The universe is ours for the taking!"
—Sanctifer LeVay, Cult of the Sacred Union

quotes.name: Farmstead Gleaner
quotes.flavor: When it finishes the harvest, you'll have nowhere to hide.

quotes.name: Narset, Jeskai Waymaster
quotes.flavor: "Each step we take is a decision that changes the course of our futures. We must be careful where we tread."

quotes.name: Hagra Mauling // Hagra Broodpit
quotes.flavor:
"I think we somehow got turned around."
—Doros, expedition guide

quotes.name: Smothering Tithe
quotes.flavor:
"They laughed with glee as the pixie spun gold from straw. They smiled and shrugged when their curtains and clothes were next on the wheel. Then he grabbed their hair."
—*The Goose Mother and Other Tales*

quotes.name: Boomerang
quotes.flavor: Early Jamuraan hunters devised a weapon that would return to its source. Tolarian Aethermancers developed a spell that skipped the weapon entirely.

quotes.name: You're Confronted by Robbers
quotes.flavor: Their only mistake was giving the bard time to speak.

quotes.name: Craven Knight
quotes.flavor: "I say victory is better than honor."

quotes.name: Ravenous Giant
quotes.flavor: The might of an army with the restraint of a child.

quotes.name: Network Disruptor
quotes.flavor: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."

quotes.name: Deadly Recluse
quotes.flavor: Even dragons fear its silken strands.

quotes.name: Engulfing Slagwurm
quotes.flavor: Its teeth exist only for decoration.

quotes.name: The Balrog, Flame of Udûn
quotes.set_name: Tales of Middle-earth Deluxe Commander Kit
quotes.flavor: An evil of the Ancient World, both a shadow and a flame.

quotes.name: Steamcore Scholar
quotes.flavor: "Hm. That's weird."

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: ... for Earth's Mightiest Heroes.

quotes.name: Captain's Call
quotes.flavor:
"Who among you has the courage to face certain death? Who will heed my call?"
—Rayel Vanger, Firstblade of Thune

quotes.name: Bob, Reluctant HYDRA Agent
quotes.flavor: "I mainly joined up for the benefits . . ."

quotes.name: Okina Nightwatch
quotes.flavor: Only the most skilled budoka could protect the Okina Shrine. Only the best of these protectors took the night watch.

quotes.name: Thriving Heath
quotes.flavor:
"Vortis is ours. We, the Menoptra, are reclaiming it."
—Vrestin

quotes.name: Baleful Force
quotes.flavor:
"As with any malevolent being, the trick is knowing how long you can afford to keep it in your service."
—Liliana Vess

quotes.name: Aggravated Assault
quotes.flavor: Despite being more cunning than most Orks, Kaptin Badrukk still recognizes that some plans just need more dakka.

quotes.name: HELIOS One
quotes.flavor: The plant is still capable of activating the devastating ARCHIMEDES satellite weapon.

quotes.name: Wyluli Wolf
quotes.flavor:
"When one wolf calls, others follow. Who wants to fight creatures that eat scorpions?"
—Maimun al-Wyluli, diary

quotes.name: Furnace Whelp
quotes.flavor: Baby dragons can't figure out humans—if they didn't want to be killed, why were they made of meat and treasure?

quotes.name: The Rack
quotes.flavor: Invented in Mishra's earlier days, the rack was once his most feared creation.

quotes.name: Loafing Giant
quotes.flavor: "Forget it. I'm not getting up today."

quotes.name: Light of Day
quotes.flavor:
"I do not miss sunlight. The very memory of it burns my eyes."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Merfolk Cave-Diver
quotes.flavor:
"Learn all you can of this underground sea. I suspect more secrets of our ancestors lie waiting in its depths."
—Tishana

quotes.name: Demonic Gifts
quotes.flavor: It began as a flavor on the tongue, like a bloody morsel of roast boar—but soon the power was a conflagration in her veins.

quotes.name: Spellseeker
quotes.flavor: Mages and warriors recruited from across Kylem display their skills at Valor's Reach.

quotes.name: Frenetic Raptor
quotes.flavor:
"How do you stop a raptor from charging? No, seriously! Help!"
—Blarg, goblin jester

quotes.name: Flowstone Thopter
quotes.flavor: Airborne flowstone isn't less dangerous, only less common.

quotes.name: Wisecrack
quotes.flavor: "I support your right to bear arms, Grizzly, but this is getting ridiculous."

quotes.name: Talisman of Hierarchy
quotes.flavor: The ghouls of the FMS *Northern Star* seemed interested in moving up in the world of business.

quotes.name: Cori Mountain Monastery
quotes.flavor: Every spire is a physical dedication to the Way.

quotes.name: Coldsteel Heart
quotes.flavor: "There is as much power in winter's chill as in summer's warmth."

quotes.name: Plains
quotes.flavor: Searching for a vanished caravan that was bound for Silverymoon, you've come to a bank of mysterious fog.

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: Rumors quickly spread among thieves about a labyrinth without walls and a prize beyond all measures of worth.

quotes.name: Pledge of Unity
quotes.flavor:
"No one hero will save this day. Today we must all be heroes."
—Gideon Jura

quotes.name: Doomed Dissenter
quotes.flavor: The most dangerous place to be in Kessig is alone.

quotes.name: Slobad, Goblin Tinkerer
quotes.flavor:
"I used to joke that he had been exiled for being too smart. Now I know why he never laughed."
—Glissa Sunseeker

quotes.name: Blacklance Paragon
quotes.flavor: The Blacklances travel deep into the wilds, sometimes for years at a time, in search of the lost Cauldron of Eternity.

quotes.name: Two-Headed Giant
quotes.flavor: He watches the pass in both directions, and all must pay his toll.

quotes.name: Phantom Monster
quotes.flavor: Is it an amalgamation of faded memories or the projection of a half-remembered dream? Neither answer offers any comfort.

quotes.name: Befriending the Moths // Imperial Moth
quotes.flavor:
"The moths of Eiganjo were once no different from any other great beast of Kamigawa's wilds. It took years of patience and dedication to convince them to bear riders."
—*History of the Empire*

quotes.name: Kataki, War's Wage
quotes.flavor:
"Before the war, we prayed to Kataki to sharpen our swords and harden our armor. Without his blessing our weapons are all but useless against the kami hordes."
—Kenzo the Hardhearted

quotes.name: Brushland
quotes.flavor:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Seer's Sundial
quotes.flavor: "The shadow travels toward the apex. I predict we will soon see the true measure of darkness."

quotes.name: Dimir Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

quotes.name: Fountain of Youth
quotes.flavor: The Fountain had stood in the town square for centuries, but only the pigeons knew its secret.

quotes.name: Kismet
quotes.flavor:
"Make people wait for what they want, and you have power over them. This is as true for merchants and militia as it is for cooks and couples."
—Gwendlyn Di Corci

quotes.name: Myr Servitor
quotes.flavor: The Krark Clan enjoys pulling them apart just to watch them reassemble one another.

quotes.name: Urborg Syphon-Mage
quotes.flavor: "I have become a gourmet of sorts. Each soul has its own distinctive flavor. The art is in inviting the right company to the feast."

quotes.name: Snakeform
quotes.flavor: Losing his possessions distressed him, but the lack of limbs was strangely liberating.

quotes.name: Enduring Scalelord
quotes.flavor: Only the sun that beats down upon Arashin's walls could shine more brightly.

quotes.name: Attentive Sunscribe
quotes.flavor: Few humans are steady-handed enough to match a gnome's precision. Even the slightest change to a single line can wildly alter a glyph's meaning.

quotes.name: Thran Dynamo
quotes.flavor: Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.

quotes.name: Pithing Needle
quotes.flavor: Occasionally a skaab remembers too much of its former life. Luckily, there's an easy cure.

quotes.name: Corpse Knight
quotes.flavor:
"With each knight that rode out from the bone-white keep, the queen's soldiers felt their courage failing."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Pest Infestation
quotes.flavor: A thousand years of history undone by one juvenile prank.

quotes.name: Border Patrol
quotes.flavor:
"We have been victims of treachery, of the Cabal, and of our own ambitions. No more."
—Commander Eesha

quotes.name: Nekrataal
quotes.flavor:
"You can't protect them all, Jace."
—Vraska

quotes.name: Final-Sting Faerie
quotes.flavor: Many heroes' last sight is a grin at the other end of a rapier.

quotes.name: Pyre Charger
quotes.flavor: His blade was forged over coals of moaning treefolk, curved at the optimum angle for severing heads, and heated to volcanic temperatures by his touch.

quotes.name: Baleful Strix
quotes.flavor: Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.

quotes.name: Oasis Ritualist
quotes.flavor: "It's only the end if we allow it."

quotes.name: Sigarda's Summons
quotes.flavor: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

quotes.name: Corrupted Conscience
quotes.flavor: Karn's creation is now his master.

quotes.name: Eat to Extinction
quotes.flavor:
"Kroxa devours what he may—not for sustenance or pleasure, but because it is his nature. He is unending hunger given form."
—Klothys, god of destiny

quotes.name: Pact of Negation
quotes.flavor: At that moment Gandalf lifted his staff, and crying aloud he smote the bridge before him.

quotes.name: Pulmonic Sliver
quotes.flavor: Like a great bellows it hisses, and its kin, both living and dead, are lifted to safety.

quotes.name: Catalog
quotes.flavor:
Though those who study are as many as the hairs on an ox, those who succeed are as rare as unicorns' horns.
—Chinese proverb

quotes.name: Worldly Counsel
quotes.flavor: Every horizon hides a new possibility.

quotes.name: Curse of Surveillance
quotes.flavor: For every eye gouged out, two blinked open.

quotes.name: Pain Magnification
quotes.flavor: The Rakdos make sure their victims remember their pain—or at least give up a little bit of their sanity in order to forget.

quotes.name: Tsabo Tavoc
quotes.flavor: "I might almost pity my enemies—if it wasn't so amusing to watch them die."

quotes.name: Marauding Boneslasher
quotes.flavor: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

quotes.name: James, Wandering Dad // Follow Him
quotes.flavor: "So long as we've got each other, that's all that matters."

quotes.name: Omniscience
quotes.flavor:
"The things I once imagined would be my greatest achievements were only the first steps toward a future I can only begin to fathom."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Zealous Guardian
quotes.flavor: Parapet watchers patrol the outer edges of the doun, signaling to others who wait patiently in shadow.

quotes.name: Self-Assembler
quotes.flavor: It sees itself in all of its creations.

quotes.name: Maestros Diabolist
quotes.flavor: "Where did I find my horned friend? Now there's a story worth telling. . . ."

quotes.name: Cryptolith Rite
quotes.flavor: The chant was incomprehensible, but its power was unmistakable.

quotes.name: Bonecrusher Giant // Stomp
quotes.flavor: Not every tale ends in glory.

quotes.name: Stark's Ingenuity
quotes.flavor: "Every detail matters. It's *my* life on the line in this thing."

quotes.name: Naturalize
quotes.flavor:
"And if you threaten me again, your shiny steel trousers will be sprouting daggerthorn vines."
—Iveta, rooftop runner

quotes.name: Scholar of Stars
quotes.flavor: "The path of the stars is as reliable as the instruments that measure them."

quotes.name: Battlefield Forge
quotes.flavor:
"As Terisiare's mines ran dry, scrap metal became increasingly plentiful."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Shinka Gatekeeper
quotes.flavor:
"Understanding is not a virtue of the ogre. Do not seek to reason your way into Shinka Keep."
—Kiku, Night's Flower

quotes.name: Gwen Stacy // Ghost-Spider
quotes.flavor: "Spiders don't hold still given any other choice, and I have all the choices in the Multiverse!"

quotes.name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
quotes.flavor: "After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."

quotes.name: Gustcloak Runner
quotes.flavor: Cabal spies trying to follow the Order's movements are constantly frustrated by tracks that stop dead.

quotes.name: Slate of Ancestry
quotes.flavor: The pattern of life can be studied like a book, if you know how to read it.

quotes.name: Chance for Glory
quotes.flavor:
"I sit in the ghosts of breezes past, and I never overheat."
—Kequia, Strixhaven first-year

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To become king of the Goblins, one must assassinate the previous king. Thus, only the most foolish seek positions of leadership.

quotes.name: Feldon of the Third Path
quotes.flavor: "She will come back to me."

quotes.name: Fanatical Strength
quotes.flavor:
"Kaya and Kellan were attacked today! This is excellent news. Clearly we are on the trail of the true killer."
—Alquist Proft, case notes

quotes.name: Beacon of Unrest
quotes.flavor: "The light of my master's guidance traverses all boundaries, even those separating life and death."

quotes.name: Carrion Ants
quotes.flavor: "'War is no picnic,' my father liked to say. But the Ants seemed to disagree." —*General Chanek Valteroth*

quotes.name: Resurrection
quotes.flavor:
"Think of this new life not as a gift from the angels but as a command to fight for their cause once more."
—War blessing of Serra

quotes.name: Formidable Speaker
quotes.flavor: Jean-Emmanuel Depraz, World Champion XXIX

quotes.name: Wirewood Pride
quotes.flavor: "Though you may leave this haven we have found, may our strength never leave you."

quotes.name: Rob the Archives
quotes.flavor: "Well, I guess stealth's out of the question."

quotes.name: Rydia's Return
quotes.flavor:
"Are you okay? You should be able to move now."
—Rydia, Summoner of Mist

quotes.name: Equilibrium
quotes.flavor: In Rath, there are only so many souls to go around.

quotes.name: Inquisition of Kozilek
quotes.flavor: You will scream out your innermost secrets just to make it stop.

quotes.name: Youthful Knight
quotes.flavor:
"Let no child be without a sword. We will all fight, for if we fail, we will certainly all die."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Saproling Migration
quotes.flavor: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.

quotes.name: Seek the Wilds
quotes.flavor: "In my downtime I used to paint the vistas. Now the vistas disappear faster than my downtime."

quotes.name: Seaside Citadel
quotes.flavor: For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.

quotes.name: Brisela, Voice of Nightmares
quotes.flavor: Flesh tears then knits anew. Bones crack, splinter, and fuse together. Two sundered bodies become one writhing mass. The one becomes Emrakul.

quotes.name: Balmor, Battlemage Captain
quotes.flavor: "Even the most hardened armies are ill-equipped to defend against an onslaught from the sky."

quotes.name: Obsidian Giant
quotes.flavor: After a while, ships stopped sailing within his reach.

quotes.name: Wizard Replica
quotes.flavor: It responds with unnatural precision.

quotes.name: The Council of Four
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Ambition has a price in Baldur's Gate, and it is paid to the Council.

quotes.name: Ringwarden Owl
quotes.flavor: The owls learn of mana from the mages who know it best.

quotes.name: Distant Melody
quotes.flavor: Oona's song is like a twisted dinner chime. All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

quotes.name: Adherent of Hope
quotes.flavor: "Basri has shown me the way forward, and I will follow."

quotes.name: Hideous End
quotes.flavor:
"A little dark magic won't stop me. The worse the curse, the better the prize."
—Radavi, Joraga relic hunter, last words

quotes.name: Precognitive Perception
quotes.flavor: "To control the present we must master the future."

quotes.name: Air Elemental
quotes.flavor: As the ship approached, the jade totem rose high overhead. Power rippled. Eyes of stone glowed and crackled. Out hissed a breath of the world, and a windstorm came alive.

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

quotes.name: Wirewood Symbiote
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: It drinks fatigue.

quotes.name: Supernatural Stamina
quotes.flavor:
"All are not equal—neither in life nor after death. Bontu's favorites will stand highest in eternity."
—Senifet, vizier of Bontu

quotes.name: Zhalfirin Void
quotes.flavor:
"The wind whispers, 'come home,' but I cannot."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Two-Headed Cerberus
quotes.flavor: The left head keeps the right head starved as motivation to track new prey.

quotes.name: Captain Mar-Vell, Space-Born
quotes.flavor: "I came here to study the people of Earth, not serve as their executioner!"

quotes.name: Selfless Spirit
quotes.flavor: "There is always more to give."

quotes.name: Terra Eternal
quotes.flavor:
"If this world could make a wish, it would be to survive the parasites who loot its treasures and threaten its life force."
—Saidah, Joraga hunter

quotes.name: Tortured Existence
quotes.flavor:
"There are terrors lurking in the unseen corners of us all."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Mind Harness
quotes.flavor: Centuries ago, Mangara won the loyalty of the Quirion not by ruling their minds but by supporting their independence.

quotes.name: Hoar Shade
quotes.flavor:
"The creature we fought in the western waste was doubly dangerous: mortally wounded, it rebounded and attacked again."
—Disa the Restless, journal entry

quotes.name: Markov Crusader
quotes.flavor: The surviving members of the Markov bloodline drove through a crush of horrors to reclaim their ancestral home.

quotes.name: Cut the Earthly Bond
quotes.flavor:
"The more kami that passed through the veil that separated them from our world, the weaker that veil became, threatening to tear into tatters at the slightest pressure."
—*The History of Kamigawa*

quotes.name: Stock Up
quotes.flavor: "We are now accepting over eleven different interplanar currencies, including polished moonfall!"

quotes.name: Thrashing Brontodon
quotes.flavor: It cares more about preserving the herd's territory than about preserving itself.

quotes.name: Profane Tutor
quotes.flavor: As Dakkon forged the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada, he unwittingly forged himself into her schemes.

quotes.name: Rally the Peasants
quotes.flavor:
"If you must go out at night, bring a mob."
—Master of the Elgaud Cathars

quotes.name: Decisive Denial
quotes.flavor: Bear Dismayed to Discover Food Chain Keeps Going

quotes.name: Kor Cartographer
quotes.flavor: Kor have no concept of exploration. They return to homelands forgotten.

quotes.name: Dust Stalker
quotes.flavor: The only traces it leaves are silent gusts and prodigious amounts of wreckage.

quotes.name: Jewel Thief
quotes.flavor: "They can afford the loss. They build it into their prices."

quotes.name: Gravewaker
quotes.flavor: It glides on silent wings across the midnight sky, and a dread host rises to follow.

quotes.name: Goblin Bombardment
quotes.flavor: One mogg to aim the catapult, one mogg to steer the rock.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor: "I do not wish for a return of the old gods, nor to recapture the glory of the past. I only wish to see my people thrive. That is enough."

quotes.name: Creature Guy
quotes.flavor: There once was a player named Quinn, . . .

quotes.name: Evolving Wilds
quotes.flavor: The Sun Empire bends nature—rivers, mountainsides, dinosaurs—to its unyielding will.

quotes.name: Icy Reception
quotes.flavor: "Keep them distracted," instructed the Theorist. Chandra's doppelganger smiled, and a chill went through the air.

quotes.name: Grim Affliction
quotes.flavor: Even the small wounds let hope bleed out.

quotes.name: Psychic Frog
quotes.flavor: Some frogs poison the body. Some frogs poison the mind.

quotes.name: Vandalblast
quotes.flavor: Beauty is in the eye of the exploder.

quotes.name: Tribute to the Wild
quotes.flavor:
"You may enter, but leave those lifeless things of your world behind."
—Modruni, maro-sorcerer

quotes.name: Zombie Master
quotes.flavor: They say the Zombie Master controlled these foul creatures even before his own death, but now that he is one of them, nothing can make them betray him.

quotes.name: Agrus Kos, Spirit of Justice
quotes.flavor: "Eventually I'll give retirement another shot. But not today."

quotes.name: Scoria Cat
quotes.flavor: Like a volcano, it too can erupt without warning.

quotes.name: Dictate of Kruphix
quotes.flavor: "Knowledge is cruel. It will break your heart and test your allegiances. Are you certain you want this curse?"

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

quotes.name: Reyav, Master Smith
quotes.flavor: "There's always room for improvement."

quotes.name: Wall of Light
quotes.flavor: As many attackers were dazzled by the wall's beauty as were halted by its force.

quotes.name: Cruel Revival
quotes.flavor: On Innistrad, Liliana embraced necromancy, honing her powers by practicing on scores of undead—and sometimes the living.

quotes.name: Culling Dais
quotes.flavor:
"Forswear the flesh and you will truly see."
—Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur

quotes.name: Pegasus Refuge
quotes.flavor:
The first Rath-born pegasus was so offended by the sky that it hid its eyes in the earth.
—Vec lore

quotes.name: Grave Pact
quotes.flavor: Denied the peace of the Blessed Sleep, geists lash out at the living, and the cycle of anger and unrest continues unbroken.

quotes.name: Auriok Edgewright
quotes.flavor: Auriok soldiers craft their own weapons, forging a connection to the steel with each blow of the hammer.

quotes.name: Archon of Justice
quotes.flavor: In dark times, Truth bears a blade.

quotes.name: Killing Wave
quotes.flavor: "Try again in the next life, darling."

quotes.name: Elvish Ranger
quotes.flavor: It's up to you if you enter their woods—and up to them if you leave.

quotes.name: Elite Spellbinder
quotes.flavor: Paulo Vitor Damo da Rosa, World Champion XXVI

quotes.name: Mana Tithe
quotes.flavor:
"The tyrant's bellow of rage trailed off into a whimper as the last of his fortune escaped his grasp."
—*The Dethroner's Grimoire*

quotes.name: Rootha, Mercurial Artist
quotes.flavor: "Art is never finished. Merely abandoned."

quotes.name: Korvold, Fae-Cursed King
quotes.flavor: Becoming a dragon only sharpened his raw ambitions.

quotes.name: Counterpoint
quotes.flavor: "Nice theory, but I'm going to have to poke some holes in it."

quotes.name: Fire-Lit Thicket
quotes.flavor:
"Welcome to Wall Market, the pleasure capital of Midgar that's got everything for everybody!"
—Wall Market barker

quotes.name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
quotes.flavor: "It is not a goal, but a process—the process of creating the perfect Phyrexia."

quotes.name: Orzhov Signet
quotes.flavor: The sigil holds different meanings depending on its form and presentation. While some wear it as a sign of status, others wear it as a sign of debt.

quotes.name: Bloodtracker
quotes.flavor: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

quotes.name: Dawn of Hope
quotes.flavor:
"To wage war, secure peace within yourself."
—Emmara

quotes.name: Necrotic Sliver
quotes.flavor: Though Volrath is long dead, the slivers have become everything he wanted them to be: mindless instruments of destruction and despair.

quotes.name: Bastion of Remembrance
quotes.flavor: Brave soldier boy comes marching home.

quotes.name: Horizon Canopy
quotes.flavor:
"Not the green and pleasant land we've been led to expect."
—The Seventh Doctor

quotes.name: Kitesail
quotes.flavor: Kitesailing is a way of life—and without practice, the end of it.

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: On the Planet of Sorcerers in the Eye of Terror lies the Tower of the Cyclops, the redoubt of Magnus the Red.

quotes.name: Inquisitive Puppet
quotes.flavor:
"The strings were gone, but he still felt the pull of invisible forces tugging at his mind."
—*Beyond the Great Henge*

quotes.name: Illithid Harvester // Plant Tadpoles
quotes.flavor: "Your mind belongs to the Emperor now."

quotes.name: Footlight Fiend
quotes.flavor:
"This footlight's broken. Get me a stagehand!"
—Judith

quotes.name: Lavalanche
quotes.flavor: Alara's burning blood cannot be contained by mere earth and stone.

quotes.name: Bioshift
quotes.flavor:
"It's all right if you change your mind. There's always a chance we can rearrange parts later."
—Zija, Simic mutationist

quotes.name: Castle Embereth
quotes.flavor: Without Embereth's courage, the realm would falter and fall.

quotes.name: Replenish
quotes.flavor: Treasures, trinkets, trash—the relics of the past are brought forth again.

quotes.name: Exuberant Firestoker
quotes.flavor: The artistry of Etlan's firedancers is more spectacular when behemoths join in.

quotes.name: Silvos, Rogue Elemental
quotes.flavor: He was born of the Mirari, thrust out of his homeland before he was even aware. Left without purpose or meaning, he found both in the pits.

quotes.name: Cryptcaller Chariot
quotes.flavor:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur

quotes.name: Wipe Away
quotes.flavor: An eyeblink later, all that remained of the tree-beast was the breeze of its momentum.

quotes.name: Aether Hub
quotes.flavor: It powers the dreams of Ghirapur.

quotes.name: Towering-Wave Mystic
quotes.flavor: Thassa's favor followed him to the Underworld. Even the waves of Nerono obeyed his will.

quotes.name: Stupefying Touch
quotes.flavor: Just because your eyes are open doesn't mean you're awake.

quotes.name: Reunion of the House
quotes.flavor:
"We stand or fall as a family. All of us."
—Betor

quotes.name: Rank Officer
quotes.flavor: It recruits the fresh and tosses the rotten.

quotes.name: Consume Spirit
quotes.flavor:
"Your blood, your marrow, your spirit—all are mine."
—Mayvar, minion of Geth

quotes.name: Ring of the Lucii
quotes.flavor:
"Kings of Lucis... come to me!"
—Noctis Lucis Caelum

quotes.name: Pacifism
quotes.flavor: For the first time in his life, Grakk felt a little warm and fuzzy inside.

quotes.name: Prodigal Sorcerer
quotes.flavor: Occasionally members of the Institute of Arcane Study acquire a taste for worldly pleasures. Seldom do they have trouble finding employment.

quotes.name: Ore-Rich Stalactite // Cosmium Catalyst
quotes.set_name: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan Commander
quotes.flavor: Deep goblins laugh at humans' wands. They cast spells with their hammers.

quotes.name: Serra Advocate
quotes.flavor: An angel's blessing prepares a soldier for war better than a thousand military drills.

quotes.name: Goblin Mountaineer
quotes.flavor: Goblin mountaineer, barely keeps his family fed.

quotes.name: Cleansing Nova
quotes.flavor:
An opal that holds limitless fire ... my love.
Leaving the world anew
With its cleansing embrace.

quotes.name: Gallantry
quotes.flavor: "Forgive me," Mirri whispered. "I thought you a burden, and you saved my life." Hanna quietly accepted the apology.

quotes.name: Wild Growth
quotes.flavor: If you stop to listen, you can hear it grow.

quotes.name: Deflection
quotes.flavor:
Up and down,
over and through,
back around—
the joke's on you.

quotes.name: Abeyance
quotes.flavor:
"I'm too modest a wizard to reveal the full extent of my abilities."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Clown Extruder
quotes.flavor: Pietra's Mirthing Pod boasts an output that's hilarious and impressive—a real laugh a minute.

quotes.name: Contentious Plan
quotes.flavor: Niv-Mizzet had perfected a plan, but he had no control over the mortal minds who had to agree to implement it.

quotes.name: Swarm of Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Rats, rats, rats! Hundreds, thousands, millions of them, and every one a life."
—Bram Stoker, *Dracula*

quotes.name: Soltari Priest
quotes.flavor: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

quotes.name: Goblin King
quotes.flavor: To be king, Numsgil did in Blog, who did in Unkful, who did in Viddle, who did in Loll, who did in Alrok . . . .

quotes.name: Searing Spear
quotes.flavor: Sometimes you die a glorious death with your sword held high. Sometimes you're just target practice.

quotes.name: Panharmonicon
quotes.flavor: All who listen hear their own song, a unique melody played just for them.

quotes.name: Cheering Crowd
quotes.flavor: "We love you, Spider-Man!"

quotes.name: Collective Unconscious
quotes.flavor: Gerrard knew little of Ramos, the sky god they worshiped. But he felt the power of the chant.

quotes.name: Animal Friend
quotes.flavor: "I scratch their back, they scratch you."

quotes.name: Curse of Predation
quotes.flavor:
"Hunters feed on the fear of their prey."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Dwynen's Elite
quotes.flavor: Call one, call them all.

quotes.name: Volcanic Island
quotes.flavor: 2018 North America Legacy Championship

quotes.name: Storrev, Devkarin Lich
quotes.flavor: In times of war, only death flourishes.

quotes.name: Skull Saucer
quotes.flavor: No body is ready for this kind of power.

quotes.name: Predator's Howl
quotes.flavor:
"And Muzzio says my arguments have no teeth."
—Selvala, ranger of the Lowlands

quotes.name: Coiling Oracle
quotes.flavor: Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.

quotes.name: Jeering Homunculus
quotes.flavor: Mklthd had always hated crowds . . . and they had always hated him.

quotes.name: Fencer Clique
quotes.flavor:
You may as well try to swat a faerie
—Flamekin expression meaning "that's impossible"

quotes.name: Fraying Omnipotence
quotes.flavor: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.
